The vendor directly providing the **Streamlabs** software product and related services at **streamlabs.com** is **Logitech Services S.A.**.

According to the official Streamlabs Terms of Service:
> *"When we say 'Streamlabs,' 'we,' 'us,' and 'our' in these terms, we mean Logitech Services S.A.. When we say 'Services' in these terms, we mean Streamlabs' services, apps, websites, and all other products."*

The website and service footers across `streamlabs.com` likewise identify the operating entity:
> *"© Logitech Services S.A. All Rights Reserved."*
